name: Fireplace, masonry, wood-burning, 72" brick breast with hearth
description: Wood-burning masonry fireplace: a brick chimney breast 72" wide, 16" deep and up to a 96" ceiling, a 36" × 28" firebox with firebrick, a raised stone hearth 18" deep and a wood mantel shelf at 54". Logs on andirons are drawn. A chimney is needed above the ceiling.
